title: I Would Like To Thank The DEA For Providing Us With Another Reason To Legalize Cannabis

content_html_sanitized:
The excellent website MarijuanaMoment.net, has a story by  Kyle Jaeger reporting, DEA Promotes Ad Campaign From Trump-Linked Group Blaming Marijuana Laced With Fentanyl For Overdose Deaths.

 

So now I have Deja Vu all over again.

 

When I got to Washington in the Fall of 1992 to become the National Director of NORML, the Prohibitionist party line was warning that children should watch out for Halloween trick or treats that were really marijuana laced with the opioid du jour. Of course , that makes no sense at all, but if the DEA says it, it must be true. Just ask The New York Post.

See

The Best Two Word Explanation for Marijuana Prohibition at The New York Post Is Amanda Devine

 

Thanks to the Iron Law of Prohibition these contraband candles are now laced with Fentanyl, at least in the better neighborhoods. After all,  Marijuana Is In Schedule One. Fentanyl Is In Schedule 2. Think About It.

 

We certainly wouldn’t want them to have something as dangerous as plain old Schedule One cannabis.

 

Sarcasm aside, one of the problems with prohibition is that no one can be confident about exactly what they are buying, and not just at Halloween. In fact, you can actually be more confident about store bought packaged candy or cannabis than with anything homemade from a neighbor who may just be a lousy cook.

See

In Defense of Cannabis Advertising

 

I’m sure these folks are just trying to save the children from improper packaging, but the Drug War has a long history of side hustles to go with the main event.

See

Even The Prohibitionists Are Attacking DARE. What Is the Definition of Fraud? Analysis By Richard Cowan

And

The Shocking Truth About Big Marijuana (Weed) (Dope)
